title.zh: Morning Minute: The CFTC Reveals Plan to Regulate Crypto Exchanges
title.en: Morning Minute: The CFTC Reveals Plan to Regulate Crypto Exchanges

current_state.zh: The CFTC published a preliminary plan to federally license and regulate crypto exchanges via proposed Regulations CTX and CAM and opened a 60-day public comment period, while the SEC cleared 3x levered Bitcoin and Ether funds for trading.
current_state.en: The CFTC published a preliminary plan to federally license and regulate crypto exchanges via proposed Regulations CTX and CAM and opened a 60-day public comment period, while the SEC cleared 3x levered Bitcoin and Ether funds for trading.
